name: Kaoru Ito
source:
Kaoru's past couldn't have been more different to her partner Tatiana's, her rough upbringing leading her to a life apart from polite society. Ever eager to share her wisdom with others, she found herself fast friends with the newcomer Shino.

[From Patreon]
